sloka: यथा हि इमे वनस्य अस्य ज्ञाताः पथि सहस्रशः ।संनताः फल भरेण पुष्प भारेण च द्रुमाः ॥३-११-४८॥
transliteration: yathā hi ime vanasya asya jñātāḥ pathi sahasraśaḥ ।saṁnatāḥ phala bhareṇa puṣpa bhāreṇa ca drumāḥ ॥3-11-48॥

translations.english: Surely this is the hermitage of great Agastya's brother, a man of holy deeds.
